mapper.sql: SELECT return_id, return_no, order_id, order_no, receive_id, receive_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, return_type, return_date, total_qty, total_amount, reason, handler_id, handler_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, outbound_order_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_return
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pms_return ( return_no, order_id, order_no, receive_id, receive_no, supplier_id, supplier_name, status, return_type, return_date, total_qty, total_amount, reason, handler_id, handler_name, audit_by, audit_time, audit_opinion, outbound_order_id, del_flag, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{returnNo}, #{orderId}, #{orderNo}, #{receiveId}, #{receiveNo}, #{supplierId}, #{supplierName}, #{status}, #{returnType}, #{returnDate}, #{totalQty}, #{totalAmount}, #{reason}, #{handlerId}, #{handlerName}, #{auditBy}, #{auditTime}, #{auditOpinion}, #{outboundOrderId}, #{delFlag}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_return SET del_flag = '2' WHERE return_id IN #{returnId}
mapper.select: SELECT detail_id, return_id, material_id, material_code, material_name, spec_model, unit, qty, unit_price, amount, return_reason, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM pms_return_detail WHERE return_id = #{returnId} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY detail_id ASC
mapper.delete: UPDATE pms_return_detail SET del_flag = '2' WHERE return_id = #{returnId}
